# The words a device rule may use

A rule is an assertion over these words and nothing else. A word an execution does not have makes a rule `does not apply` (never `holds`).

## The device

| Word | Is | Meaning | Read off a programme | Read off a timed schedule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `angle(n, r1, r2)` | degrees | The angle at node n between rails r1 and r2, as drawn. |  | n/a |
| `c2lr_device()` | true or false | Whether the device is a C2LR swap-or-stay lattice: it declares C2LR control, and its drawing is a lattice of junctions with one leg on every wire (arXiv:2403.00756). |  | n/a |
| `c2lr_wiring()` | true or false | Whether a device that declares C2LR control is driven as C2LR is: a fixed number of shared analog signals, plus one digital input and one switch per leg, over a lattice of legs. |  | n/a |
| `can(s, a)` | true or false | Whether site s is equipped for ability a: "gate" (a laser gate), "spam" (preparation and measurement) or "cool" (cooling). |  | A paper's device that declares no abilities is taken to allow everything; its own rules then say where each operation may run. |
| `capacity(x)` | a number | How many ions the site or rail x may hold at once, as the device declares it. |  |  |
| `control()` | a name | How the device's electrodes are driven: "direct" (every electrode its own signal) or a broadcast scheme where many share one waveform. |  | n/a |
| `cross(r1, r2)` | true or false | Whether rails r1 and r2 cross each other at a point that is not a node they share. |  | n/a |
| `degree(n)` | a number | How many rails meet at node n. |  |  |
| `ends(r)` | a set of nodes | The two nodes rail r joins. |  |  |
| `heat_budget()` | quanta | The hottest an ion may be when a two-ion gate starts (its motional quanta n̄), as the device declares it; no limit when it declares none. |  | n/a |
| `junctions` | a set of nodes | The nodes where three or more rails meet, whatever the device calls them. An ion crosses a junction; whether it may stop there is a rule. |  |  |
| `legs` | a set of sites | The legs of a C2LR lattice: the trap at the centre of every wire between two junctions, each holding one two-ion crystal (one ion of this model). Empty on any other device. |  | n/a |
| `lies_on(n, r)` | true or false | Whether node n lies on rail r's line without being one of its ends -- a rail drawn straight through a node it does not stop at. |  | n/a |
| `max_classes()` | a number | How many different motions the device's control system can drive in one step. |  | n/a |
| `max_junction_degree()` | a number | The most rails a junction of this device may join, as its document declares (6 when it says nothing: a junction of a trap built in more than one layer joins up to six). |  | n/a |
| `min_rail_angle()` | degrees | The smallest angle two rails meeting at a node may make, as the device's document declares (60 degrees when it says nothing). |  | n/a |
| `neighbours(s1, s2)` | true or false | Whether sites s1 and s2 are neighbouring zones that a two-ion gate may span (some devices gate across two zones of one rail). |  |  |
| `nodes` | a set of nodes | Every node of the device: its sites and its junctions. |  |  |
| `priced(j)` | true or false | Whether the device declares the time it takes to cross junction j, at j's number of rails. |  | n/a |
| `rails` | a set of rails | The rails (segments) along which ions are carried between nodes. |  |  |
| `rails_at(n)` | a set of rails | The rails that end at node n. |  |  |
| `rotated(n)` | true or false | Whether node n is a slot of a loop or rail that this programme moves as a whole (a conveyor), which carries every ion through every slot. |  | n/a |
| `sites` | a set of sites | Every place an ion can stand: the traps, the docks, the slots of a loop. A node where rails cross only to pass through it is not a site. |  |  |
| `zone(s)` | a name | The zone type of site s (for example "gate", "storage", "O"). |  |  |

## The execution

| Word | Is | Meaning | Read off a programme | Read off a timed schedule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `abs(x)` | a number | The size of a number, without its sign. |  |  |
| `approx(x, y)` | true or false | Whether two durations agree to within the execution's rounding (one part in a million). |  |  |
| `at_chain_end(o)` | true or false | Whether split o takes the ion at the end of its chain that faces the rail it leaves by. | A programme does not record the order inside a chain, so only a chain of at most two ions is known to have every ion at an end. | Read from the chain order, tracked event by event as the paper's model does. |
| `bits_only(k)` | true or false | Whether transport step k, if it is of a C2LR class, chooses nothing per leg but the direction bit: it is the device's template, not routes the programme wrote. |  | n/a |
| `c2lr_step(k)` | true or false | Whether step k is a C2LR template step: a swap-or-stay or a reorder-or-not, played by the device's shared waveforms. |  | n/a |
| `carries_gates(k)` | true or false | Whether step k also names gates. |  | n/a |
| `claimed(c)` | a number | The value claim c states. |  | n/a |
| `claims` | a set of claims | Every figure the programme states about itself: its total time, cost and steps, and per-instruction annotations. |  | n/a |
| `class_declared(k)` | true or false | Whether transport step k's movement class is one the device declares (or the device declares none to check against). |  | n/a |
| `clock(o)` | microseconds | How long the execution's clock says operation o takes: the paper's own duration law; none where an operation is not one the model has. | n/a |  |
| `clocked(o)` | true or false | Whether the clock makes a claim about operation o. For a schedule this website wrote itself, every operation must be one the paper's model times; a paper's own schedule may contain operations its law does not time. | n/a |  |
| `coolings` | a set of operations | Every cooling operation. |  |  |
| `crossed(o)` | a set of junctions | The junctions transport operation o carries its ion into, on the way or to stop. |  |  |
| `declared_sites(o)` | a set of sites | The sites the programme itself names for operation o, if it names any (a claim the replay checks). |  | Empty: where a paper's operation says it happens is checked with its ions (found). |
| `disjoint(A, B)` | true or false | Whether sets A and B have nothing in common. |  |  |
| `drivable(k)` | true or false | Whether the device's control channels can drive step k: one channel carries one waveform, so every ion a channel moves must move the same way, and a site may sit a step out only if it has its own switch. |  | n/a |
| `duration(o)` | microseconds | How long operation o lasts. | Its step's duration under the device's clock (the slowest operation of the step). |  |
| `end(o)` | an instant | The instant operation o is over. | The instant after o's step. |  |
| `exchange(x)` | true or false | Whether x -- a step, an instant, an operation or a hop -- belongs to a C2LR swap-or-stay step, whose crystals exchange through the junctions by the device's matching: the routes are derived from the device, never read from the programme, so a programme cannot claim this for a move it wrote itself. | An instant is the one during such a step; an operation or hop is one of its moves. | Never: a paper's timed schedule has no swap-or-stay steps, so R2, R3, R5 and R22 judge all of it. |
| `exits_as_entered(k)` | true or false | Whether every crystal that leaves, in step k, a leg holding two under C1's exception is the one that entered it, leaving by the step type it entered by -- and whether every crystal step k shifts toward a junction could reach it. |  | n/a |
| `form(k)` | a name | How swap-or-stay step k pairs the legs: "diagonal" (every junction pairs the same two of its legs, as demonstrated) or "checkerboard" (two pairs at the junctions of one colour, the proposal's, assumed). |  | n/a |
| `found(o)` | true or false | Whether operation o finds its ions where it says they are and leaves them where the next operation expects them. | The replay refuses a programme that does not, so this always holds once it runs. | Replayed event by event. |
| `from(o)` | a node | Where transport operation o (or hop o) picks its ion up. |  |  |
| `gates` | a set of operations | Every laser gate, on one ion or on two. |  |  |
| `heats_every_crystal(k)` | true or false | Whether C2LR step k heats every crystal on the device -- the ones that move and the ones that stay -- as every waveform plays on every leg. |  | n/a |
| `hops` | a set of hops | Every rail crossed by an ion: one transport operation over three rails is three hops. |  | n/a |
| `independent_axes(k)` | true or false | Whether, in swap-or-stay step k, a crystal on a horizontal leg and one on a vertical leg set their bits independently: true of the template, which carries one bit per crystal and no field per axis. |  | n/a |
| `ions` | a set of ions | Every ion of the execution. At the machine level, ions(b) is block b's ions. |  |  |
| `ions(o)` | a set of ions | The ions operation o acts on or carries. |  |  |
| `is_transport(k)` | true or false | Whether step k moves ions. |  | n/a |
| `kind(o)` | a name | What operation o is: "gate2", "gate1", "measure", "reset", "cool", "swap", or a transport kind ("move", "split", "merge", "shuttle", "junction_enter", "junction_exit", "hop"). |  |  |
| `locks(o)` | a set of names | The components the schedule itself says operation o holds while it runs. | n/a |  |
| `loop(h)` | a loop name | The closed loop hop h runs along, or none. |  | n/a |
| `matched(k)` | true or false | Whether swap-or-stay step k is the device's matching: every crystal it shifts toward a junction has a partner leg there under the step's variation, and the device offers that variation. |  | n/a |
| `max(x, y)` | a number | The larger of two numbers. |  |  |
| `measurements` | a set of operations | Every measurement of an ion. |  |  |
| `min(x, y)` | a number | The smaller of two numbers. |  |  |
| `mode(k)` | a name | Whether transport step k moves ions inside traps ("intra") or between them ("inter"). |  | n/a |
| `motion(o)` | a name | The waveform transport operation o needs: its movement class and, hop by hop, its direction -- along a loop as "+1"/"-1", on a spur as inward/outward, elsewhere as the lab-frame axis. Two ions with the same motion can ride one waveform. |  | The class the paper's schedule records for the operation. |
| `one_waveform(k)` | true or false | Whether swap-or-stay step k is one shared waveform: the replay prices it as one primitive, whose time is the step's however many crystals move. |  | n/a |
| `operations` | a set of operations | Every operation of the execution, of any kind. |  |  |
| `passes(o)` | a set of nodes | The nodes transport operation o carries its ion through without stopping: its path without the two ends. |  |  |
| `path(o)` | a list of nodes | The nodes transport operation o carries its ion through, first to last. |  |  |
| `rail(h)` | a rail | The rail hop h crosses. |  | n/a |
| `rails_used(o)` | a set of rails | The rails transport operation o uses. |  |  |
| `replayed(c)` | a number | The value the replay computes for what claim c is about. |  | n/a |
| `resets` | a set of operations | Every reset (preparation) of an ion. |  |  |
| `setup_ok()` | true or false | Whether the execution's starting placement puts every ion in a site that exists, once. |  |  |
| `shift(h)` | a number | How many slots along its loop hop h moves its ion, with a sign for the direction. |  | n/a |
| `simultaneous(a, b)` | true or false | Whether operations a and b happen at the same time. | In the same step. | Their time intervals overlap (an interval ends where the next may begin). |
| `single_qubit_gates` | a set of operations | Every gate that acts on one ion. |  |  |
| `site(o)` | a site | Where operation o happens. For a gate, the site its ions stand in when it starts; none for transport and for operations on every ion at once. |  |  |
| `size(A)` | a number | How many things set A holds. |  |  |
| `splits` | a set of operations | Every operation that lifts an ion out of the chain it stood in. | A move whose motion includes a split (the device's movement class says so). |  |
| `start(o)` | an instant | The instant operation o begins. | The instant before o's step. |  |
| `step(o)` | a step | The step operation o belongs to. |  | n/a |
| `steps` | a set of steps | The steps of a programme: one instruction each, run one after another; everything in one step happens together. |  | n/a |
| `swap_paid(o)` | true or false | Whether the reordering that brings split o's ion to the end of its chain was paid for. | The step records the gate swaps it pays. | The split carries a reorder the paper's model charges. |
| `swaps` | a set of operations | Every reordering of two ions inside one chain. |  |  |
| `to(o)` | a node | Where transport operation o (or hop o) leaves its ion. |  |  |
| `transport` | a set of operations | Every operation that carries an ion along the rails. | One operation per moving ion per step, from where it stood to where it stops. | Each split, merge, rail crossing, junction entry and exit, or hop the paper records. |
| `two_qubit_gates` | a set of operations | Every gate that acts on two ions together. |  |  |
| `well_formed(o)` | true or false | Whether operation o names ions, sites and rails that exist and ends no earlier than it starts. |  |  |

## Instants and the state

| Word | Is | Meaning | Read off a programme | Read off a timed schedule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entered(s, t)` | true or false | Whether leg s holds two crystals at instant t under C1's exception: one of them entered it by a swap-or-stay enter -- moved toward the junction into a leg whose crystal stayed -- and has not left. | During a step, it holds if it held before the step or holds after it. | n/a |
| `final()` | an instant | The last instant of the execution, when everything is over. |  |  |
| `heat(i, t)` | quanta | Ion i's motional energy n̄ (in quanta) at instant t, under the device's heating model. Known at the start of every two-ion gate. |  | n/a |
| `instants` | a set of instants | Every moment at which the state of the machine is judged. | The moment before each step, the moment during each step that moves ions, and the end. | The start, and every time an operation begins or ends. |
| `occupancy(x, t)` | a number | How many ions are in site, junction or rail x at instant t. | During a step that moves ions, a site counts the ions that rest there before or after the step, whichever is more, plus every ion that passes through it: the programme does not order what happens inside a step, so nothing may be assumed to leave first. A rail counts the ions crossing it. | An ion counts in a trap from the moment it starts to arrive until the moment it has left, and on a rail or in a junction while it is there. |
| `position(i, t)` | a site | The site where ion i stands at instant t; none while it is in motion. |  |  |

## The input circuit

| Word | Is | Meaning | Read off a programme | Read off a timed schedule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `circuit_ops` | a set of circuit operations | The operations of the input circuit that the execution is judged against. | Every operation of the circuit. | Its two-qubit gates: the only operations a paper's schedule names ions for. |
| `computes_circuit()` | true or false | Whether the programme computes the input circuit: every gate of the circuit is performed once, in order, by its own ions, together in a trap that can gate, and the pulses fired compose to the circuit's operation. |  | n/a |
| `first(c)` | an operation | The first operation that carries out circuit operation c. |  |  |
| `gate_count(c)` | a number | How many two-qubit gates of the execution carry out circuit operation c. |  |  |
| `last(c)` | an operation | The last operation that carries out circuit operation c. |  |  |
| `needs_gate(c)` | true or false | Whether circuit operation c is a two-qubit gate, which the execution must perform once. |  |  |
| `next_on_qubit(c1, c2)` | true or false | Whether c2 is the operation that comes right after c1 on one of their qubits, in the circuit as written. |  |  |
| `next_run(c1, c2)` | true or false | Whether c2 belongs to the run of gates that follows c1's run on a qubit they share. A run is a stretch of consecutive CNOTs in which that qubit plays the same role -- always the control, or always the target -- and such gates commute with each other. |  |  |
| `performed(c)` | true or false | Whether some operation of the execution carries out circuit operation c. |  |  |
| `performers(c)` | a set of operations | The operations of the execution that carry out circuit operation c. | Every instruction the compiler stamped with c. | The two-qubit gate matched to c: the k-th gate on a pair of ions is the circuit's k-th gate on that pair. |
| `serves_circuit(o)` | true or false | Whether two-qubit gate o carries out some gate of the circuit. |  |  |

## The clock

| Word | Is | Meaning | Read off a programme | Read off a timed schedule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `com_frequency_held()` | true or false | Whether the device's swap-or-stay step records the centre-of-mass frequency it holds a crystal at during a shift. A property of the waveform, recorded, not decided from a programme; a device that records none leaves the rule unchecked. |  | n/a |
| `declares_duty_budget()` | true or false | Whether the device declares how much heat a gate zone may absorb over time (a duty-cycle budget). |  | n/a |
| `gate_error_reads_heat()` | true or false | Whether the gate error the clock reports depends on the ions' heat when the gate starts, rather than being a constant. |  | n/a |
| `heat_accrues_with_time()` | true or false | Whether the clock heats every ion for elapsed time, moving or not. |  | n/a |
| `heat_is_upper_bound()` | true or false | Whether the heat figures the clock reports are upper bounds: heat from successive motions is added, and the interference that can make it smaller is not modelled. |  | n/a |
| `models_heating()` | true or false | Whether the device's clock tracks how hot each ion gets. |  | n/a |
